job.job_description:
Full stack AI Engineer
Job Title: Full Stack Developer - Agentic AI & GenAI Engineer
Experience: 4-8 Years
Job Summary:
We are looking for an experienced Full Stack Developer with expertise in Python, FastAPI, Next.js, React, AWS, and Agentic AI/GenAI. The role involves developing scalable full-stack applications, building AI-powered workflows, integrating LLMs and RAG pipelines, and deploying production-ready solutions using Docker and CI/CD.
Required Skills:

Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, SQLAlchemy, PostgreSQL/MySQL.
Next.js, React.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, HTML5, CSS3.
AWS ECS, EC2, S3, Docker, ECR, and CI/CD pipelines.
Agentic AI, GenAI, AI Agents, LLM integration (OpenAI, Anthropic, AWS Bedrock).
RAG, embeddings, vector databases, OpenSearch, and multi-step AI workflows.
Database design, API integration, authentication (JWT/OAuth2), and application security.
Cloud deployment, performance optimization, scalability, and production support.
Unit testing, Git, microservices, and Agile methodologies.
Good to have:Terraform, Redis, Kafka, Celery, Kubernetes, and observability tools.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and end-to-end ownership skills.
Good-to-Have Skills:

Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation)
Celery, SQS, Kafka, Redis, and asynchronous processing
Kubernetes (EKS), Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Datadog
AI agent frameworks and AG-UI or similar frameworks
AWS certifications in Solutions Architecture or DevOps.
Qualifications:
Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
Proven experience delivering and maintaining production-ready full-stack applications.
Strong problem-solving, communication, and end-to-end ownership skills.
Work Mode :
Full-time
Job :
IT&Services
Location :
Remote
Years of Experience :
4-8
